title: Delivery fields
prompt:
Order J-64: 7 purple notebooks; destination Surat. Extract order_id,quantity,color,city. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: order_id, quantity, color, city. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
